{{Quote|Independent commerce is the backbone of Corellian culture. Every sentient being should be free to make his way in the universe. The Open Shipping Consortium seeks to enrich this system's discreet-shipping climate with fresh ideas, technology and manpower.|The Open Shipping Consortium|<ref name="SWG:PTFC">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Powermongers Throttle Free Commerce}} on Corellia</ref>}}
The '''Open Shipping Consortium''', abbreviated '''OSC''', was an organization charged with representing and protecting the commercial interests of [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. Rather progressive, the Open Shipping Consortium competed with the conservative [[Corellian Discreet Shipping Industry Chamber of Commerce]] (CDSICoC). The OSC was favorable to the opening of Corellian shipping lanes to offworlders while the CDSICoC was firmly opposed to this measure. The Open Shipping Consortium considered that commerce should be as open as possible and argued that such reform would enrich Corellian pilots. After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the rivalry between the two organizations escalated into conflict.<ref name="SWG:PTFC" /> In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]],<ref name="SWG_timeline">{{SWG_timeline}}</ref> when a freighter dumped several cargoes of dangerous animals into populated areas of [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]], each organization blamed pilots affiliated with its concurrent to be responsible for the situation. Then, both the OSC and the CDSICoC recruited [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] to hunt the creatures.<ref name="SWG:PTFC" /><ref name="SWG:CDSICoCMA">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=terminal||Corellian Discreet Shipping Industry Chamber of Commerce Menace Again}} on Corellia</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Open Shipping Consortium was mentioned in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Roleplaying game|massively multiplayer online role-playing game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:PTFC" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Open Shipping Consortium was mentioned in two missions called "Corellian Discreet Shipping Industry Chamber of Commerce Menace Again" and "Powermongers Throttle Free Commerce" available on [[mission terminal]]s on Corellia.<ref name="SWG:PTFC" /><ref name="SWG:CDSICoCMA" />
